name: IVF & Assisted Reproductive Technology
nameAr: علاج الخصوبة وأطفال الأنابيب
summary: DHA-regulated In Vitro Fertilization (IVF), Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI), pre-implantation genetic testing (PGT-A/PGT-M), egg vitrification, and reproductive endocrinology treatments under UAE Federal Law No. 7 on Assisted Reproduction.
insuranceCoverage: Selective employer policies & specialized fertility riders; diagnostic workups covered under standard Dubai insurance tiers (Saada, Enaya, Thiqa).
dhaRequirements: Clinics must possess DHA Level III Assisted Reproductive Facility License, ISO-certified cleanroom laboratories, and DHA-credentialed embryology directors.

faqs.q: What is the average cost of an IVF cycle in Dubai?
faqs.a: A standard IVF cycle in Dubai typically ranges between AED 18,000 and AED 35,000, excluding pre-implantation genetic testing (PGT) and specialized medications.

faqs.q: Does UAE medical insurance cover IVF treatments?
faqs.a: Diagnostic fertility investigations (hormone blood panels, semen analysis, pelvic ultrasounds) are usually covered. Full IVF cycles are covered under premium executive plans or specific government wellness riders like Saada and Enaya.

faqs.q: What DHA regulations govern embryo freezing in Dubai?
faqs.a: Under UAE Federal Law No. 7 and DHA guidelines, married couples can store cryopreserved embryos, eggs, and sperm for up to 5 years (renewable) in DHA-inspected cryobanks.

faqs.q: How long does a full IVF treatment cycle take?
faqs.a: A typical IVF cycle takes between 4 to 6 weeks from ovarian stimulation and egg retrieval to embryo transfer and subsequent beta-hCG pregnancy confirmation.

name: Cardiology & Interventional Heart Care
nameAr: أمراض القلب والأوعية الدموية والتداخلية
summary: Comprehensive clinical and interventional cardiology diagnostics, 24/7 cardiac catheterization, coronary stenting, echocardiography, Holter monitoring, and preventative cardiac health screening supervised by DHA-licensed consultant cardiologists.
insuranceCoverage: Fully covered across basic, enhanced, and comprehensive Dubai health insurance plans (Saada, Enaya, NextCare, MetLife, AXA, Cigna).
dhaRequirements: Facilities must operate 24/7 cardiac emergency protocols, ACLS-certified nursing staff, and DHA-accredited digital catheterization laboratories.

faqs.q: When should I consult a cardiologist in Dubai?
faqs.a: You should consult a cardiologist if you experience chest tightness, shortness of breath, unexplained palpitations, dizziness, or if you have risk factors such as hypertension, diabetes, or a family history of heart disease.

faqs.q: Are cardiac diagnostic tests covered by Dubai health insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, medically indicated ECGs, echocardiograms, stress tests, and Holter monitoring are covered under standard DHA-mandated insurance with a physician referral.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a cardiologist and a cardiac surgeon?
faqs.a: A cardiologist specializes in medical and catheter-based interventional diagnosis and treatment, whereas a cardiac surgeon performs open-heart surgical procedures like bypasses and valve replacements.

faqs.q: How often should adults undergo preventative heart screening in Dubai?
faqs.a: Adults aged 35 and older with cardiovascular risk factors are recommended by DHA guidelines to complete an annual cardiac risk assessment including lipid profiling and ECG.

name: Obstetrics & Gynecology (OB-GYN)
nameAr: طب النساء والولادة ورعاية الحوامل
summary: Specialized women's healthcare covering routine antenatal checkups, high-risk pregnancy management, normal and cesarean delivery suites, minimally invasive gynecological surgery, PCOS management, and routine cervical Pap smears.
insuranceCoverage: Maternity benefits are mandatory across all DHA-compliant insurance policies with standard delivery and antenatal packages.
dhaRequirements: Maternity units must maintain Level II/III neonatal support, 24/7 on-call obstetric surgical teams, and continuous fetal monitoring systems.

faqs.q: Is maternity care covered by mandatory Dubai insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, under DHA health insurance regulations, all insured residents have access to standard antenatal consultations, 8-12 routine visits, ultrasounds, and basic inpatient delivery coverage.

faqs.q: What is included in a Dubai antenatal care package?
faqs.a: Antenatal packages typically include monthly consultations, anomaly scans (12-week nuchal translucency, 20-week anomaly), routine blood tests, glucose tolerance tests, and cardiotocography (CTG).

faqs.q: Can I choose between natural birth and planned C-section in Dubai hospitals?
faqs.a: Yes, Dubai hospitals provide patient-centered birthing plans in consultation with your DHA-licensed obstetrician, adhering to clinical safety guidelines.

faqs.q: How often should women schedule routine gynecological exams?
faqs.a: Annual well-woman checkups including pelvic examination, Pap smear (every 3 years), and breast examinations are recommended for women aged 21 and above.

name: Pediatrics & Neonatal Intensive Care
nameAr: طب الأطفال وحديثي الولادة والعناية المركزة
summary: Specialized pediatric clinical consultations, newborn developmental assessments, DHA mandatory childhood vaccinations, pediatric allergy management, and Level III Neonatal Intensive Care (NICU) for premature infants.
keyProcedures: Level III NICU Specialized Incubator Care
insuranceCoverage: Child healthcare and routine DHA immunizations are covered under all standard family insurance plans across the UAE.
dhaRequirements: Pediatric emergency clinics must have dedicated child resuscitation equipment, pediatric-trained nurses, and cold-chain vaccine storage inspected by DHA.

faqs.q: Which vaccines are mandatory for children in Dubai?
faqs.a: The DHA national immunization schedule includes BCG, Hepatitis B, DTaP, Polio, Hib, Rotavirus, PCV, MMR, Varicella, and Hepatitis A administered from birth to school age.

faqs.q: Are pediatric walk-in clinics available for emergencies?
faqs.a: Yes, major hospitals like Al Jalila Children's, Medcare Women & Children, and American Hospital Dubai operate dedicated 24/7 pediatric urgent care and emergency departments.

faqs.q: What developmental milestones should pediatricians monitor?
faqs.a: Pediatricians monitor motor skills, speech and language milestones, social engagement, head circumference, weight-for-age percentiles, and sensory development.

faqs.q: Can I get a pediatrician to visit my child at home in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, DHA-licensed home healthcare services provide pediatric doctor home visits for routine consultations, viral fever monitoring, and at-home checkups.

name: Dermatology, Laser & Aesthetic Medicine
nameAr: الجلدية والعلاج بالليزر والطب التجميلي
summary: Medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology providing evidence-based treatment for acne, eczema, psoriasis, skin cancer biopsies, mole mapping, medical lasers, chemical peels, and aesthetic skin rejuvenation.
insuranceCoverage: Medical dermatology (eczema, severe cystic acne, psoriasis, suspicious skin lesions) is covered; cosmetic aesthetic procedures are self-pay.
dhaRequirements: Cosmetic lasers and aesthetic injections must be performed strictly by DHA-licensed dermatologists or certified laser therapists in inspected clinical rooms.

faqs.q: Does Dubai health insurance cover dermatology visits?
faqs.a: Medical conditions such as chronic dermatitis, fungal infections, severe acne, suspicious moles, and psoriasis consultations are covered with standard insurance co-pay.

faqs.q: How do I verify a dermatologist's DHA license?
faqs.a: You can verify any dermatologist's credentials through the official DHA Sheryan licensing registry using the practitioner's full name or DHA license number.

faqs.q: What is digital mole mapping and why is it important in Dubai?
faqs.a: Digital mole mapping uses high-resolution dermoscopy to track skin lesions over time, allowing early detection of melanoma and non-melanoma skin cancers in sunny climates.

faqs.q: What laser technologies are approved by the DHA for skin resurfacing?
faqs.a: DHA-approved clinics utilize FDA-cleared fractional CO2, Nd:YAG, Pico lasers, and pulsed dye lasers operated strictly within safety emission thresholds.

name: Orthopedic Surgery, Joint & Sports Medicine
nameAr: جراحة العظام والمفاصل والطب الرياضي
summary: State-of-the-art orthopedic interventions including robotic knee and hip joint replacements, minimally invasive arthroscopic ligament reconstruction (ACL/PCL), spine disc surgery, and sports injury rehabilitation.
insuranceCoverage: Orthopedic surgery, trauma stabilization, joint replacements, and post-op physiotherapy are extensively covered under standard network plans.
dhaRequirements: Operating theaters must meet laminar air flow Level 1 surgical standards with integrated C-arm fluoroscopy and dedicated orthopedic implants tracking.

faqs.q: How long is recovery after arthroscopic knee surgery in Dubai?
faqs.a: Most patients walk with crutches within 24 to 48 hours, begin targeted physiotherapy within 5 days, and return to light activity within 4 to 6 weeks.

faqs.q: Are robotic joint replacements available in Dubai hospitals?
faqs.a: Yes, leading facilities like King's College Hospital, American Hospital, and Fakeeh University Hospital offer robotic-assisted Mako and Rosa joint replacements.

faqs.q: Does insurance cover sports injury physiotherapy in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, physician-prescribed physiotherapy sessions (usually 6-12 sessions per approval cycle) are covered under Dubai health insurance plans.

faqs.q: What non-surgical treatments are available for joint arthritis?
faqs.a: Non-surgical options include hyaluronic acid injections, PRP regenerative joint injections, specialized physiotherapy, and ultrasound-guided steroid injections.

name: General & Minimally Invasive Laparoscopic Surgery
nameAr: الجراحة العامة والجراحة بالمنظار
summary: Specialized general and advanced laparoscopic surgical procedures including hernia repairs, gallbladder removals (cholecystectomy), appendectomies, thyroid surgeries, and bariatric weight-loss interventions.
keyProcedures: Laparoscopic Inguinal & Ventral Hernia Mesh Repair
insuranceCoverage: Medically necessary surgical procedures, emergency abdominal operations, and hernia repairs are fully covered under Dubai insurance policies.
dhaRequirements: Surgical centers must comply with DHA day-surgery or tertiary hospital criteria with high-definition laparoscopy towers and 24/7 post-anesthesia care units.

faqs.q: What are the benefits of laparoscopic surgery compared to open surgery?
faqs.a: Laparoscopic surgery uses keyhole incisions resulting in significantly less post-operative pain, minimal scarring, shorter hospital stays (often day-care), and faster return to work.

faqs.q: Is bariatric weight loss surgery covered by insurance in Dubai?
faqs.a: Insurance coverage for bariatric surgery requires meeting strict DHA and insurer criteria (typically BMI ≥ 40 or BMI ≥ 35 with co-morbidities like Type 2 diabetes or sleep apnea).

faqs.q: How long is the hospital stay for laparoscopic gallbladder removal?
faqs.a: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy is typically performed as a day-case procedure or requires an overnight stay of 24 hours under observation.

faqs.q: What pre-operative medical tests are required before surgery in Dubai?
faqs.a: Standard pre-op workup includes complete blood count, coagulation profile, kidney function, ECG, chest X-ray, and pre-anesthetic consultation.

name: Dentistry, Orthodontics & Oral Surgery
nameAr: طب وجراحة الأسنان وتقويم الأسنان وزراعتها
summary: Full-spectrum dental medicine featuring titanium dental implants, digital clear aligners, microscopic root canal therapy, porcelain veneers, pediatric dentistry, and complex surgical extraction of impacted wisdom teeth.
keyProcedures: Surgical Extraction of Impacted Wisdom Teeth
insuranceCoverage: Emergency dental pain relief, simple extractions, and basic restorative fillings are included in standard policies; comprehensive dental riders cover root canals and crowns.
dhaRequirements: Dental clinics must feature Class B autoclaves, digital low-radiation panoramic/CBCT X-rays, and strict DHA infection control protocols.

faqs.q: What is the cost of dental implants in Dubai?
faqs.a: A high-grade European or American dental implant (including titanium fixture, abutment, and crown) typically costs between AED 3,500 and AED 8,500 per tooth in Dubai.

faqs.q: Does health insurance cover orthodontic clear aligners in Dubai?
faqs.a: Clear aligners are generally categorized as aesthetic treatments and are self-pay, although medical dental riders may provide partial orthodontic coverage for teens.

faqs.q: Is dental sedation available for anxious patients in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, DHA-licensed surgical dental centers provide nitrous oxide (laughing gas) and IV conscious sedation supervised by licensed anesthesiologists.

faqs.q: How often should I get a dental cleaning and checkup?
faqs.a: DHA dental guidelines recommend professional scaling, polishing, and examination every 6 months to prevent periodontal disease and decay.

name: Ophthalmology, LASIK & Vitreoretinal Care
nameAr: طب وجراحة العيون وتصحيح النظر بالليزك
summary: Advanced eye care including refractive Femto-LASIK and SMILE vision correction, phacoemulsification cataract surgery with premium intraocular lenses, glaucoma laser management, and diabetic retinopathy anti-VEGF injections.
insuranceCoverage: Medical ophthalmology (cataracts, glaucoma, diabetic eye care, corneal disease) is fully covered; elective LASIK is generally self-pay with flexible clinic packages.
dhaRequirements: Refractive suites must operate temperature and humidity-controlled HEPA-filtered cleanrooms with calibrated excimer and femtosecond laser systems.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for LASIK or SMILE eye surgery in Dubai?
faqs.a: Candidates must be at least 18 years old, have stable vision for 12 months, adequate corneal thickness, and no severe dry eye or active corneal pathology verified via corneal topography.

faqs.q: Is cataract surgery covered by Dubai medical insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, medically indicated cataract extraction with standard monofocal intraocular lenses is covered under all approved Dubai insurance tiers.

faqs.q: How fast is vision recovery following Femto-LASIK?
faqs.a: Most patients achieve 20/20 vision within 24 hours of Femto-LASIK and can resume normal computer work and daily routines within 2 to 3 days.

faqs.q: How often should diabetic patients get eye examinations?
faqs.a: DHA diabetic clinical protocols mandate a dilated retinal exam at least once a year to detect early diabetic retinopathy before irreversible vision impairment occurs.

name: Neurology, Neurosurgery & Spine Health
nameAr: طب وجراحة المخ والأعصاب والعمود الفقري
summary: Specialized neurological evaluation and cranial/spinal neurosurgery for conditions including migraine, epilepsy, stroke rehabilitation, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, brain tumors, and herniated spinal disc disease.
keyProcedures: Botox Therapy for Chronic Refractory Migraine
insuranceCoverage: Inpatient and outpatient neurological assessments, diagnostic neuroimaging (MRI/CT), and neurosurgical procedures are covered under comprehensive Dubai policies.
dhaRequirements: Tertiary hospitals providing neurosurgery must maintain 24/7 dedicated neuro-ICU beds, intraoperative neuro-monitoring (IONM), and neuro-navigation systems.

faqs.q: When should I see a neurologist for headaches?
faqs.a: Consult a neurologist if headaches are sudden and severe ('thunderclap'), accompanied by visual disturbances, numbness, weakness, confusion, or if over-the-counter painkillers fail to provide relief.

faqs.q: What is an EMG test and what conditions does it diagnose?
faqs.a: An electromyogram (EMG) measures muscle electrical activity and nerve conduction velocity, diagnosing carpal tunnel syndrome, peripheral neuropathy, and sciatica.

faqs.q: Are acute stroke treatments available 24/7 in Dubai hospitals?
faqs.a: Yes, DHA-designated stroke centers such as Rashid Hospital and King's College Hospital provide 24/7 rapid IV thrombolysis and endovascular mechanical thrombectomy.

faqs.q: What non-surgical options exist for chronic back and neck pain?
faqs.a: Non-surgical treatments include targeted nerve root blocks, epidural steroid injections, radiofrequency neurotomy, and specialized spinal rehabilitation.

name: Diagnostic Radiology & Medical Imaging
nameAr: الأشعة التشخيصية والتصوير الطبي المتطور
summary: High-precision diagnostic imaging utilizing 3.0 Tesla MRI, 128/256-slice CT scanning, 3D digital mammography (tomosynthesis), high-resolution color Doppler ultrasound, and DEXA bone density quantification.
insuranceCoverage: Diagnostic imaging with a valid physician referral is covered across all standard and premium network plans in Dubai.
dhaRequirements: Imaging centers must be registered with the UAE Federal Authority for Nuclear Regulation (FANR) and inspected by DHA for radiation protection standards.

faqs.q: How soon are MRI and CT scan reports available in Dubai?
faqs.a: Digital images are typically available immediately on patient portals, with verified consultant radiologist written reports delivered within 12 to 24 hours (or stat in 2 hours for urgent cases).

faqs.q: Do I need a doctor's referral for an MRI scan in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, for health insurance coverage, a formal prescription and clinical justification from a DHA-licensed physician is required prior to pre-authorization.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 1.5T and 3.0T MRI scanners?
faqs.a: A 3.0 Tesla MRI scanner operates at twice the magnetic field strength of a 1.5T scanner, producing significantly higher resolution images of fine brain, nerve, and joint structures in less scan time.

faqs.q: At what age should women in Dubai begin routine screening mammograms?
faqs.a: DHA Basma guidelines recommend women aged 40 and above undergo screening mammography every 2 years, or earlier if there is a significant family history of breast cancer.

name: Clinical Pathology & Diagnostic Laboratory
nameAr: المختبرات الطبية والتحاليل والأمراض السريرية
summary: CAP and ISO-15189 accredited clinical pathology laboratories providing rapid biochemistry panels, hematology, immunology, molecular PCR diagnostics, allergy profiles, and histopathology tissue biopsies.
keyProcedures: Thyroid Profile (TSH, Free T3, Free T4)
Vitamin D, B12 & Ferritin Iron Studies
insuranceCoverage: Physician-ordered routine diagnostic laboratory tests are covered across all standard DHA-approved insurance policies.
dhaRequirements: Laboratories must hold DHA Tier 1 clinical lab licenses, participate in international proficiency testing (RIQAS/CAP), and maintain temperature-monitored specimen logistics.

faqs.q: Can I request lab blood test sample collection at home in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, DHA-licensed laboratories offer mobile phlebotomy services where a certified nurse collects blood, urine, or swab samples directly at your residence or workplace.

faqs.q: How long do routine blood test results take in Dubai?
faqs.a: Routine tests like CBC, lipid profile, and liver/kidney function tests are typically reported within 4 to 8 hours digitally via email or mobile app.

faqs.q: Do I need to fast before my blood tests?
faqs.a: Fasting (usually 8 to 12 hours with plain water permitted) is required for fasting glucose, lipid profiles, and certain metabolic panels. Always follow specific clinic instructions.

faqs.q: What is the difference between home blood test packages and doctor-ordered tests?
faqs.a: Home health wellness packages provide preventative screening overviews, whereas doctor-ordered tests target specific diagnostic symptoms and are eligible for insurance reimbursement.

name: Endocrinology, Diabetes & Metabolism
nameAr: أمراض الغدد الصماء والسكري والتمثيل الغذائي
summary: Comprehensive management of Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes mellitus, insulin pump optimization, continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), thyroid nodules, pituitary disorders, osteoporosis, and metabolic obesity.
insuranceCoverage: Diabetes management is a core chronic disease mandate under DHA regulations with comprehensive coverage for medications, insulin, and diabetic supplies.
dhaRequirements: Diabetes centers must align with the DHA Dubai Diabetes Care Pathway, ensuring annual retinopathy screening, podiatry exams, and nephropathy checks.

faqs.q: What is the normal target HbA1c for diabetic patients in Dubai?
faqs.a: For most non-pregnant adults with diabetes, the DHA clinical target is an HbA1c below 7.0%, tailored individually based on age, duration of diabetes, and cardiovascular health.

faqs.q: Are continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors covered by insurance?
faqs.a: CGM systems (such as FreeStyle Libre and Dexcom) are covered under enhanced and premium Dubai insurance tiers for Type 1 and insulin-dependent Type 2 diabetes patients.

faqs.q: What are the common symptoms of thyroid dysfunction?
faqs.a: Hypothyroidism (underactive) presents with chronic fatigue, unexpected weight gain, dry skin, and cold intolerance; hyperthyroidism (overactive) causes rapid heartbeat, tremors, weight loss, and heat sensitivity.

faqs.q: What specialized diabetic foot care is recommended by the DHA?
faqs.a: Diabetic patients should undergo a formal annual foot assessment by a podiatrist or diabetologist using monofilament sensory testing and Doppler vascular checks to prevent diabetic ulcers.

name: Gastroenterology, Hepatology & Endoscopy
nameAr: أمراض الجهاز الهضمي والكبد والمناظير
summary: Specialized diagnosis and treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's/Colitis), irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), liver fatty infiltration, diagnostic gastroscopy, and screening colonoscopy.
keyProcedures: Colorectal Cancer Screening Colonoscopy with Polypectomy
insuranceCoverage: Gastroenterological consultations, therapeutic endoscopies, colon cancer screening, and liver workups are covered with prior medical authorization.
dhaRequirements: Endoscopy units must feature automated endoscope reprocessors (AER), conscious sedation monitoring suites, and dedicated recovery recovery beds.

faqs.q: At what age should screening colonoscopy begin in Dubai?
faqs.a: Under DHA and international preventive guidelines, average-risk individuals should begin screening colonoscopy at age 45, or 10 years earlier if there is a first-degree family history of colorectal cancer.

faqs.q: Is endoscopy painful and what sedation is used?
faqs.a: Both gastroscopy and colonoscopy are performed under light IV conscious sedation (propofol/midazolam) supervised by an anesthesiologist; patients sleep comfortably and feel no pain.

faqs.q: What is a FibroScan test for the liver?
faqs.a: FibroScan is a non-invasive, painless ultrasound-based shear-wave elastography test that measures liver fibrosis and fat percentage (steatosis) within 10 minutes without needles or biopsies.

faqs.q: What are the common symptoms of H. Pylori stomach infection?
faqs.a: Symptoms include burning upper abdominal pain, bloating, frequent burping, nausea, acid reflux, and unintentional weight loss, diagnosed accurately via a simple breath or stool antigen test.

name: Urology, Andrology & Men's Health
nameAr: جراحة المسالك البولية وأمراض الذكورة
summary: Clinical evaluation and minimally invasive surgical management of kidney stones (laser lithotripsy), benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH / Rezum / TURP), male subfertility, erectile dysfunction, and urinary incontinence.
keyProcedures: Laser Lithotripsy for Kidney & Ureteral Stones
Rezum & TURP Minimally Invasive Prostate Surgery
insuranceCoverage: Kidney stone treatments, prostate procedures, urinary infections, and urological oncology are covered; specialized sexual health therapies are self-pay.
dhaRequirements: Operating facilities must have holmium or thulium surgical laser suites, C-arm imaging, and strict protocols for endoscopic sterile processing.

faqs.q: How are kidney stones removed without open surgery in Dubai?
faqs.a: Surgeons use flexible ureteroscopy (RIRS) paired with holmium laser fiber to pulverize stones into dust through natural urinary passages without surgical cuts.

faqs.q: What is the Rezum water vapor therapy for enlarged prostate?
faqs.a: Rezum is a 10-minute day-case procedure using sterile water vapor (steam) to shrink enlarged prostate tissue with minimal recovery time and preserved sexual function.

faqs.q: When should men start prostate cancer PSA blood screening?
faqs.a: DHA urology guidelines recommend men aged 50 and above (or age 45 for those with a family history) have an annual Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) blood test and clinical exam.

faqs.q: Can male fertility be improved through minor surgery?
faqs.a: Yes, microsurgical subinguinal varicocelectomy repairs enlarged testicular veins, frequently improving sperm count, motility, and DNA fragmentation index within 3 to 6 months.

name: ENT (Otolaryngology) & Head and Neck Surgery
nameAr: الأنف والأذن والحنجرة وجراحة الرأس والرقبة
summary: Medical and surgical management of chronic sinusitis, nasal septum deviation, sleep apnea and snoring, tonsil and adenoid hypertrophy in children, hearing impairment, tinnitus, and vertigo/balance disorders.
keyProcedures: Pure Tone Audiometry & Tympanometry Hearing Tests
insuranceCoverage: Sinusitis surgeries, tonsillectomies, septoplasties with breathing impairment, and diagnostic audiology are covered under UAE health insurance.
dhaRequirements: Audiology soundproof booths must meet ANSI background noise criteria, and surgical centers must feature high-magnification ear microscopes and HD endoscopes.

faqs.q: What is coblation tonsillectomy and how does it compare to traditional surgery?
faqs.a: Coblation utilizes controlled radiofrequency energy to dissolve tissue at lower temperatures (40-70°C), causing significantly less thermal damage, less pain, and quicker recovery in children.

faqs.q: Can chronic nasal congestion and snoring be permanently fixed?
faqs.a: Yes, correcting deviated nasal septums (septoplasty), shrinking turbinates (coblation), and treating chronic sinus polyps (FESS) provides permanent structural airflow improvement.

faqs.q: What causes sudden vertigo and inner ear dizziness?
faqs.a: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) is the most common cause, triggered by displaced inner ear canaliths and successfully treated with the Epley canalith repositioning maneuver.

faqs.q: Are hearing aids covered by insurance in Dubai?
faqs.a: Diagnostic hearing evaluations are covered; hearing aid devices and specialized cochlear implants are covered under specific enhanced government plans and pediatric riders.

name: Medical Oncology, Hematology & Cancer Care
nameAr: علاج الأورام وأمراض الدم والعلاج الكيميائي
summary: Multidisciplinary cancer management aligned with the DHA Basma initiative, offering targeted immunotherapy, systemic chemotherapy, hormonal therapy, bone marrow evaluation, and personalized genetic genomic profiling.
insuranceCoverage: DHA's Basma initiative provides complete coverage for breast, colorectal, and cervical cancer screening and treatments for all basic Dubai insurance cardholders.
dhaRequirements: Oncology day-care infusion suites must feature negative-pressure cytotoxic compounding laminar cleanrooms, specialized oncology pharmacists, and emergency anaphylaxis teams.

faqs.q: What is the DHA Basma initiative for cancer patients in Dubai?
faqs.a: Basma is a Dubai Health Authority initiative that guarantees comprehensive cancer screening, diagnosis, and treatment for breast, colorectal, and cervical cancers for all residents, including basic insurance plan holders.

faqs.q: What is a Multidisciplinary Tumor Board (MDT)?
faqs.a: An MDT is a formal panel where medical oncologists, surgical oncologists, radiation specialists, pathologists, and radiologists collectively review a patient's case to design the best personalized treatment plan.

faqs.q: How does targeted therapy and immunotherapy differ from traditional chemotherapy?
faqs.a: Unlike traditional chemotherapy which attacks all rapidly dividing cells, targeted therapy blocks specific molecular mutations in cancer cells, while immunotherapy empowers the patient's own immune system to destroy tumors with fewer side effects.

faqs.q: Are second medical opinions encouraged for cancer diagnoses in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, cancer care guidelines strongly recommend second opinions before starting major systemic or surgical interventions, and Dubai oncology centers facilitate seamless cross-consultations.

name: Pulmonology, Respiratory Care & Sleep Studies
nameAr: أمراض الجهاز التنفسي والرئة واضطرابات النوم
summary: Specialized respiratory evaluation for chronic bronchial asthma, COPD, pulmonary fibrosis, chronic cough, respiratory allergies, and overnight polysomnography sleep apnea studies with CPAP titration.
insuranceCoverage: Pulmonology consultations, spirometry, and medically necessary sleep studies for sleep apnea are covered across standard UAE health insurance.
dhaRequirements: Sleep laboratories must operate sound-attenuated private rooms with continuous multi-channel infrared video recording and certified polysomnographic technologists.

faqs.q: What is an overnight sleep study (polysomnography) in Dubai?
faqs.a: Polysomnography records your brain waves, blood oxygen levels, heart rate, breathing patterns, and eye/leg movements while you sleep in a specialized clinic room to diagnose obstructive sleep apnea.

faqs.q: How does dusty weather in Dubai affect asthma and COPD patients?
faqs.a: Airborne dust and seasonal humidity can trigger severe bronchial hyperreactivity and flare-ups; pulmonologists prescribe maintenance controller inhalers and peak flow monitoring to protect airways.

faqs.q: What is a spirometry test and how is it conducted?
faqs.a: Spirometry measures how much air you can inhale and how quickly you can exhale into a computerized mouthpiece, diagnosing asthma and airway obstruction within 15 minutes.

faqs.q: Is CPAP therapy covered by health insurance for sleep apnea?
faqs.a: Yes, when sleep apnea is diagnosed with a moderate-to-severe Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI > 15), medical insurance frequently covers CPAP machines and masks upon physician pre-authorization.

name: Nephrology, Renal Care & Hemodialysis
nameAr: أمراض الكلى والغسيل الكلوي ورعاية زراعة الكلى
summary: Specialized nephrological care for acute and chronic kidney disease (CKD), diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, hypertension-induced kidney damage, state-of-the-art hemodialysis, and post-transplant immunosuppression follow-up.
insuranceCoverage: Hemodialysis and nephrology hospital care are categorized as life-sustaining treatments and are covered across all UAE insurance tiers.
dhaRequirements: Hemodialysis centers must feature dual-pass reverse osmosis water purification plants with monthly microbiological testing and dedicated isolated suites for viral hepatitis patients.

faqs.q: Can visiting tourists and expatriates access hemodialysis in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, private dialysis centers and major hospitals offer guest dialysis for tourists and business travelers with advance scheduling and medical summaries.

faqs.q: How can diabetic patients prevent kidney disease in Dubai?
faqs.a: Annual microalbuminuria urine testing, strict blood pressure control (< 130/80 mmHg), optimal HbA1c control, and avoiding unprescribed NSAID painkillers protect kidney filtration.

faqs.q: What is the difference between hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis?
faqs.a: Hemodialysis cleanses blood through an external machine at a clinic 3 times a week, while peritoneal dialysis uses the lining of your abdomen to filter blood at home daily.

faqs.q: What medical signs indicate kidney failure?
faqs.a: Early stages are often silent; advanced symptoms include swelling in the ankles and face (edema), fatigue, foamy urine, decreased urine output, and persistent nausea.

name: Psychiatry, Clinical Psychology & Mental Health
nameAr: الطب النفسي وعلم النفس والصحة النفسية
summary: Evidence-based mental healthcare delivering psychiatric evaluations, medication management, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), adult and child ADHD assessments, anxiety/depression therapies, and burnout resilience counseling.
insuranceCoverage: Mental health consultations and psychotherapy are increasingly covered under enhanced UAE policies in accordance with national mental wellness frameworks.
dhaRequirements: Practitioners must hold active DHA psychiatric or clinical psychology licensure and provide strictly confidential, secure electronic clinical records.

faqs.q: Are mental health consultations confidential in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, strictly protected under UAE Federal and DHA healthcare privacy laws; all psychiatric consultations, therapy notes, and prescriptions remain strictly confidential between doctor and patient.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a psychiatrist and a psychologist?
faqs.a: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor (MD) who can diagnose mental conditions and prescribe medications; a psychologist holds a PhD/PsyD in psychology and specializes in psychotherapy and behavioral assessments.

faqs.q: Can I consult a psychiatrist via video online in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, DHA-licensed telehealth providers provide compliant online video psychotherapy and psychiatric consultations from home.

faqs.q: How is adult ADHD diagnosed in Dubai clinics?
faqs.a: Adult ADHD diagnosis involves structured clinical interviews (DIVA-5), standardized behavioral questionnaires, cognitive screening, and developmental history review.

name: Physiotherapy & Physical Rehabilitation
nameAr: العلاج الطبيعي والتأهيل الحركي والرياضي
summary: Specialized musculoskeletal physiotherapy, post-operative orthopedic recovery, sports biomechanics, neurological stroke rehabilitation, pediatric developmental therapy, and dry needling by DHA-licensed physical therapists.
insuranceCoverage: Physiotherapy is widely covered under Dubai health insurance with a referral from an orthopedic doctor, rheumatologist, or neurologist.
dhaRequirements: Centers must have dedicated gymnasiums with approved therapeutic modalities, shockwave units, and DHA-registered physical therapy practitioners.

faqs.q: How many physiotherapy sessions are usually approved by insurance?
faqs.a: Insurers typically approve an initial package of 6 to 10 sessions upon receiving a doctor's referral, with extensions granted based on objective progress reports.

faqs.q: What is dry needling and how does it help muscle pain?
faqs.a: Dry needling involves inserting micro-fine filiform needles into muscular trigger points to release tight muscle knots, enhance local blood flow, and relieve chronic stiffness.

faqs.q: Can I receive physiotherapy at home in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, DHA-licensed home care agencies provide certified physical therapists who bring portable exercise and electrotherapy equipment directly to your home.

faqs.q: How soon after knee or shoulder surgery should physiotherapy start?
faqs.a: Gentle range-of-motion exercises usually begin within 24 to 48 hours post-op under surgeon guidelines, transitioning into active strengthening over subsequent weeks.

name: Home Healthcare & Skilled Clinical Nursing
nameAr: الرعاية الصحية المنزلية والتمريض السريري المتخصص
summary: DHA-licensed home healthcare services offering 24/7 skilled clinical nursing, post-surgical wound dressing, elderly chronic care, IV vitamin/antibiotic infusions, catheter maintenance, and palliative home support.
keyProcedures: Home IV Infusion Therapy & Medication Administration
Postnatal Mother & Newborn Care at Home
insuranceCoverage: Post-discharge skilled home nursing and chronic wound care are covered under enhanced and premium insurance policies upon physician justification.
dhaRequirements: Home care companies must hold specific DHA Home Healthcare Facility licenses, employ BLS-certified nurses, and comply with clinical waste disposal standards.

faqs.q: Are home nurses in Dubai licensed by the DHA?
faqs.a: Yes, all professional home nurses must hold active DHA nursing licenses, valid BLS certification, and have completed accredited nursing degrees.

faqs.q: What clinical services can be administered at home?
faqs.a: Services include vital signs monitoring, IV medications and fluid drips, wound dressings, tracheostomy care, blood glucose monitoring, catheter changes, and post-operative recovery.

faqs.q: How quickly can a home nurse be dispatched in Dubai?
faqs.a: Most DHA-licensed home healthcare providers can dispatch a nurse within 2 to 4 hours of booking confirmation across all Dubai districts.

faqs.q: Is newborn and mother care available at home after delivery?
faqs.a: Yes, specialized maternity home nurses assist new mothers with lactation support, newborn bathing, sleep tracking, and vital checks in the comfort of home.

name: Telehealth & Online Video Consultations
nameAr: الاستشارات الطبية عن بعد والطب الاتصالي
summary: DHA-compliant virtual medical consultations with board-certified doctors, instant electronic prescriptions (e-Rx) delivered to Dubai pharmacies, follow-up lab reviews, and chronic medication refills from anywhere.
insuranceCoverage: Telehealth consultations are covered under most Dubai insurance networks, reimbursing at identical or preferential co-pays compared to in-person visits.
dhaRequirements: Telehealth platforms must be encrypted, integrated with the DHA NABIDH electronic health record network, and licensed under DHA Telehealth Standards.

faqs.q: Can doctors issue valid prescriptions during a telehealth consultation in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, DHA-licensed physicians can issue digital electronic prescriptions (e-Rx) via the unified health system, which are instantly accepted at licensed pharmacies across the UAE.

faqs.q: Does my insurance cover online video consultations in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, since DHA standardized telemedicine regulations, insurance networks (including Saada, NextCare, MetLife, Cigna) cover telehealth visits with direct billing.

faqs.q: What medical conditions are appropriate for video consultations?
faqs.a: Ideal for cold/flu symptoms, skin rashes, chronic medication refills, lab result interpretations, routine follow-ups, pediatric questions, and mental health counseling.

faqs.q: What happens if the doctor determines I need an in-person physical exam?
faqs.a: If physical examination or diagnostics are required, the telehealth physician will refer you to an affiliated in-clinic facility or arrange a home doctor visit.

name: Rheumatology & Autoimmune Joint Disease
nameAr: أمراض الروماتيزم والتهاب المفاصل والمناعة الذاتية
summary: Specialized diagnosis and biological treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), ankylosing spondylitis, gout, psoriatic arthritis, fibromyalgia, and osteoporosis.
insuranceCoverage: Rheumatological assessments, autoimmune laboratory panels, and biological infusions are covered under standard medical insurance.
dhaRequirements: Day infusion units for biological therapies must have emergency resuscitation backup and specialized biologic medication storage monitored continuously.

faqs.q: What is the difference between osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis?
faqs.a: Osteoarthritis is a mechanical 'wear and tear' degeneration of cartilage, whereas rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune condition where the body's immune system mistakenly attacks joint linings.

faqs.q: Are biological therapies covered by Dubai health insurance for arthritis?
faqs.a: Yes, advanced biologics (such as anti-TNF and IL-6 inhibitors) are covered with medical prior authorization when conventional treatments prove insufficient.

faqs.q: What blood tests diagnose autoimmune diseases like lupus and RA?
faqs.a: Rheumatologists check Anti-Nuclear Antibodies (ANA), Rheumatoid Factor (RF), Anti-Cyclic Citrullinated Peptide (Anti-CCP), ESR, and C-reactive protein (CRP).

faqs.q: Can ultrasound detect joint inflammation before damage occurs?
faqs.a: Yes, high-resolution musculoskeletal ultrasound detects early subclinical synovitis and increased power Doppler signals before irreversible bone erosion appears on X-rays.

name: Plastic, Reconstructive & Cosmetic Surgery
nameAr: جراحة التجميل والترميم والجراحة التقويمية
summary: DHA-board-certified cosmetic and reconstructive plastic surgery including rhinoplasty, liposuction, abdominoplasty (tummy tuck), breast augmentation and reduction, post-bariatric body contouring, and reconstructive flap surgery.
insuranceCoverage: Reconstructive procedures following trauma, burn injury, or post-mastectomy breast reconstruction are covered; purely aesthetic procedures are self-pay.
dhaRequirements: Surgeons must hold DHA consultant/specialist plastic surgery licenses, and facilities must operate hospital-grade sterile OR suites with post-op nursing care.

faqs.q: How can I verify a plastic surgeon's credentials in Dubai?
faqs.a: Verify on the DHA Sheryan portal that the practitioner holds a 'Specialist' or 'Consultant Plastic Surgeon' title, rather than a general practitioner performing cosmetic procedures.

faqs.q: What is the typical recovery time after a tummy tuck (abdominoplasty)?
faqs.a: Most patients resume light daily walking within 3 to 5 days, wear a compression garment for 6 weeks, and return to full physical exercise after 6 to 8 weeks.

faqs.q: Is breast reconstruction after cancer surgery covered by Dubai insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, post-mastectomy breast reconstruction is recognized as medically necessary reconstructive surgery and is covered under health insurance policies.

faqs.q: What is the difference between VASER liposuction and standard liposuction?
faqs.a: VASER uses ultrasound energy to liquefy fat cells before gentle suctioning, resulting in less bruising, smoother skin retraction, and faster recovery.

name: Vascular & Endovascular Surgery
nameAr: جراحة الأوعية الدموية والقسطرة التداخلية
summary: Advanced minimally invasive treatment of varicose veins (laser EVLT / radiofrequency ablation), deep vein thrombosis (DVT), peripheral arterial disease (PAD), diabetic limb salvage, and carotid artery stenting.
insuranceCoverage: Symptomatic varicose veins causing pain, venous ulcers, DVT treatment, and peripheral arterial disease are covered under standard medical insurance.
dhaRequirements: Centers must feature vascular duplex ultrasound systems and angiography hybrid operating suites with sterile vascular catheterization capabilities.

faqs.q: Is varicose vein laser ablation covered by health insurance in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, when duplex ultrasound demonstrates significant venous reflux and patients suffer from aching, swelling, or skin changes, EVLT is covered with insurance pre-authorization.

faqs.q: How long does endovenous laser treatment (EVLT) take?
faqs.a: EVLT takes approximately 45 to 60 minutes per leg under local tumescent anesthesia, and patients can walk immediately and return to work the next day.

faqs.q: What are the warning signs of Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT)?
faqs.a: Symptoms include sudden unilateral leg swelling, calf tenderness, warmth, and redness, requiring urgent ultrasound diagnosis to prevent pulmonary embolism.

faqs.q: How does peripheral artery disease (PAD) affect walking?
faqs.a: PAD causes intermittent claudication—cramping leg pain when walking that resolves with rest due to narrowed blood vessels supplying the leg muscles.

name: Urgent Care & 24/7 Emergency Medicine
nameAr: طب الطوارئ والحالات الحرجة والرعاية العاجلة
summary: Round-the-clock emergency medical care, acute trauma stabilization, urgent pediatric evaluations, minor wound suturing, fracture splinting, and immediate critical care triage in DHA-accredited emergency departments.
insuranceCoverage: Medical emergencies are covered by law across all health facilities in the UAE regardless of network affiliation.
dhaRequirements: Emergency departments must operate 24/7 with dedicated resuscitation rooms, CT scanners, blood bank access, and direct ambulance bays connected to DCAS.

faqs.q: Does my insurance cover emergency room visits at any hospital in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, under UAE Federal and DHA laws, acute emergency stabilization is covered across all licensed hospitals, even if the facility is outside your specific network tier.

faqs.q: What is the difference between an Urgent Care Clinic and an Emergency Room?
faqs.a: Urgent Care treats non-life-threatening conditions (minor cuts, sprains, moderate fevers, minor burns) with shorter wait times; ERs handle severe life-threatening conditions (chest pain, severe head trauma, breathing failure).

faqs.q: What is the emergency ambulance phone number in Dubai?
faqs.a: Dial 998 for the Dubai Corporation for Ambulance Services (DCAS) in medical emergencies, or 999 for the Dubai Police.

faqs.q: What medical documents should I bring to a Dubai emergency room?
faqs.a: Bring your Emirates ID (or passport/visa for visitors) and insurance card. However, in critical emergencies, lifesaving treatment is initiated immediately prior to registration.

name: Allergy & Clinical Immunology
nameAr: أمراض الحساسية والمناعة السريرية
summary: Specialized diagnostic testing and desensitization immunotherapy for environmental allergies, allergic rhinitis, food intolerances, drug allergies, chronic urticaria (hives), and primary immunodeficiency disorders.
keyProcedures: Allergy Skin Prick Testing (Inhalant & Food Panels)
insuranceCoverage: Allergy consultations, diagnostic skin prick tests, and specific IgE blood panels are covered under standard medical insurance plans.
dhaRequirements: Allergy testing suites must have emergency adrenaline (epinephrine) kits, oxygen, and resuscitation equipment on immediate standby during provocation testing.

faqs.q: How does allergy immunotherapy (allergy shots/drops) work?
faqs.a: Immunotherapy exposes your immune system to gradually increasing micro-doses of your specific allergen over 3 to 5 years, training the body to develop natural immune tolerance and permanently reducing symptoms.

faqs.q: What are the most common environmental allergens in Dubai?
faqs.a: House dust mites, desert flora pollens (date palm, Prosopis tree), mold spores from AC cooling ducts, and cat dander are the most prevalent triggers in the UAE.

faqs.q: What is the difference between skin prick testing and blood allergy tests?
faqs.a: Skin prick tests provide results in 15 to 20 minutes directly on the forearm, while specific IgE blood tests are preferred if patients have severe eczema or cannot stop taking antihistamines.

faqs.q: Can food allergies be cured in children?
faqs.a: Many children outgrow allergies to milk, egg, and wheat by school age; peanut and tree nut allergies tend to persist but can be managed safely under pediatric allergy supervision.

name: Pediatric Surgery & Specialized Child Operations
nameAr: جراحة الأطفال والجراحات التخصصية للأطفال
summary: Specialized surgical interventions for infants, children, and adolescents, including neonatal congenital malformation repairs, pediatric hernia surgery, circumcisions, undescended testes (orchiopexy), and pediatric trauma.
insuranceCoverage: Medically indicated pediatric surgeries, congenital anomaly corrections, and emergency procedures are covered under family health insurance policies.
dhaRequirements: Facilities performing pediatric surgery must feature pediatric anesthesiologists, child-sized surgical instrumentation, and dedicated pediatric recovery wards.

faqs.q: Why should my child see a pediatric surgeon instead of a general surgeon?
faqs.a: Pediatric surgeons complete specialized multi-year training focusing solely on the unique anatomical, physiological, and emotional requirements of growing infants and children.

faqs.q: What is the ideal age for newborn circumcision in Dubai?
faqs.a: Pediatric surgeons recommend circumcision within the first 1 to 4 weeks of life when healing is fastest and local anesthesia provides optimal comfort.

faqs.q: How is pediatric anesthesia managed safely in Dubai hospitals?
faqs.a: DHA regulations mandate that pediatric operations are conducted by certified pediatric anesthesiologists using ultra-precise micro-dosing and continuous physiological monitoring.

faqs.q: How long is recovery after a pediatric hernia repair?
faqs.a: Pediatric hernia repair is performed as a day-case surgery; children are usually active and playful within 24 to 48 hours with dissolvable stitches.

name: Mobile Lab Phlebotomy & At-Home Sample Collection
nameAr: سحب العينات المخبرية المنزلية والفحوصات المتنقلة
summary: DHA-certified mobile phlebotomy bringing hospital-grade blood draws, urine and stool collection, genetic swabs, and rapid health checkups directly to your residence, villa, or office across all Dubai districts.
keyProcedures: Food Intolerance & Allergy Home Blood Kits
insuranceCoverage: Physician-ordered diagnostic tests collected at home are eligible for insurance reimbursement; home convenience call-out fees (AED 100-200) are typically self-pay.
dhaRequirements: Mobile phlebotomists must hold DHA phlebotomy or nursing licenses and transport samples in calibrated cold-chain carriers (2-8°C) directly to ISO-15189 labs.

faqs.q: How do I schedule an at-home blood sample collection in Dubai?
faqs.a: You can select your preferred tests online, choose your preferred morning time slot, and a DHA-licensed phlebotomist will arrive at your home with sterile collection equipment.

faqs.q: Are home blood draw results as accurate as in-hospital laboratory tests?
faqs.a: Yes, samples are collected using identical vacuum tubes, barcoded on-site, transported in temperature-controlled cold containers, and processed on automated hospital lab analyzers.

faqs.q: Is home phlebotomy suitable for elderly patients and infants?
faqs.a: Yes, mobile phlebotomy is especially beneficial for elderly patients with mobility constraints and infants who are calmer in their familiar home environment.

faqs.q: How soon do I receive my test results from home blood draws?
faqs.a: Routine blood results are delivered digitally via email or mobile portal within 4 to 8 hours of sample collection.
